subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

It is reported that __she has win__ a prize money of ten lakhs at a reality show.
solution:
The correct answer is "**she has won.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **The sentence is in the present perfect tense, which is formed with "has/have" + past participle**.

 
 
• Example: He has completed his work.
 
 
 
• **"Win" is an irregular verb, and its past participle form is "won".**(<span sty
